title: Prevent cross-asset revision and economic-event identity collisions
instructions: QUALITY AUDIT / CAPITAL FLOW ONLY. Start from exact base_sha. Concrete bug: FlowObservation.revision_key currently omits asset, so two PIT-visible BTC/ETH records with the same source, source_record_id, family, metric can be collapsed by select_latest_revisions. Independently, suppress_duplicates groups by (family, metric, economic_event_id), omitting asset, so BTC and ETH observations of the same event id but distinct source_record_id can collapse across assets. Correct identity/grouping to preserve both assets, while retaining within-asset latest-available revision behavior and deterministic cross-provider economic-event dedup. Add deterministic regression tests for (1) same source record identity, distinct BTC/ETH assets and values/provenance surviving normalize_and_dedup; (2) same economic_event_id, distinct BTC/ETH assets and distinct record ids surviving; (3) within-BTC revisions still selecting later available correction after PIT filter; (4) within-BTC duplicate providers still deduplicating deterministically; (5) reversed input order invariance. Do not broaden to units, provider collectors, scoring, predictions, execution, or other files. Preserve point-in-time availability, missingness, context-only isolation, dependence, source provenance, frozen scoring, and audit decisions. Run only the two listed pytest commands; executor enforces git diff --check separately. Fail closed if tests fail. No access to main/private/Railway/prediction/API/journals/Telegram/MT5/broker/execution/secrets.
